description: Erection of a joint first-floor rear extension at nos. 14 and 16 Lingwood Road.
decision_conditions: <p><span id="docs-internal-guid-50f1dcc8-7fff-527a-08e4-a3821d265621"><span style="font-variant-alternates: normal; font-variant-numeric: normal; font-variant-east-asian: normal; font-variant-position: normal; vertical-align: baseline;">The proposed first floor rear extensions to both Nos. 14 and 16 Lingwood Road, by reason of their excessive size, bulk, depth, and cumulative massing alongside the substantial lower floor rear extensions of these properties, would appear overly bulky and dominant, and fail to remain subordinate to the host dwellings, harming the character and appearance of the host properties and surrounding area, particularly when viewed from Spring Hill Recreation Ground. The proposal is therefore contrary to policies D1 (</span></span><span style="text-align: justify; font-variant-numeric: normal; font-variant-east-asian: normal; font-variant-alternates: normal; font-variant-position: normal; font-variant-emoji: normal; vertical-align: baseline;">London’s form, character and capacity for growth), </span><span style="text-align: justify;">D3 (</span><span style="text-align: justify; font-variant-numeric: normal; font-variant-east-asian: normal; font-variant-alternates: normal; font-variant-position: normal; font-variant-emoji: normal; vertical-align: baseline;">Optimising site capacity through the design-led approach),</span><span style="text-align: justify;">&nbsp;and D4 (Delivering good design) of the London Plan (2021), policies LP1 (</span><span id="docs-internal-guid-1b3ab4f2-7fff-c47a-3764-ab6b6fcbbdf1" style="text-align: justify;"><span style="font-variant-numeric: normal; font-variant-east-asian: normal; font-variant-alternates: normal; font-variant-position: normal; font-variant-emoji: normal; vertical-align: baseline;">Design Quality and Local Character)</span></span><span style="text-align: justify;">&nbsp;and LP17 (Housing Design) of the Hackney Local Plan 2033 (2020), and Hackney's Residential Extensions and Alterations SPD (2025).</span></p><p><span id="docs-internal-guid-a68b4386-7fff-aec5-1eba-4f9b2e31b09c"></span><span style="text-align: justify;"><br></span></p><p><span><span style="font-variant-ligatures: normal; font-variant-alternates: normal; font-variant-numeric: normal; font-variant-east-asian: normal; font-variant-position: normal; vertical-align: baseline;"><span id="docs-internal-guid-f700815e-7fff-52c1-ac43-b7e6b6e58bf1"></span><br></span></span></p>
